_what_this_is: Every Monday (Tuesday after a Monday holiday) at the entry window, one put calendar at the expected-move-down strike and one call calendar at the expected-move-up strike: short legs expiring that week's Friday, long legs the following Monday. The module is a forward EXIT-PARAMETER EXPERIMENT, not a strategy with an opinion: a `control` book that closes everything at Friday's bell, a permissive `path` book that holds every leg to its expiry and records the full per-tick mark path, and a read-side derivation (exit_policies.py) that replays profit targets, stops, strike-touch, exit-timing and long-disposition variants over that recorded path with exact pairing. Copy to config.json (git-ignored) or ~/.cherrypick/config/calendars.json.
_symbols_note: v1 is SPX only. The structure needs an index product with Monday AND Friday weekly expirations; single stocks list Fridays only, so the exact 4DTE/7DTE Monday shape does not exist for them. QQQ/IWM have the expirations but are American-style ETFs — see cash_settled_symbols before adding either.
_occ_roots_note: The OCC root the provider admits per underlying. Load-bearing on third-Friday weeks, when the cache can hold BOTH the AM-settled monthly (root SPX) and the PM-settled weekly (root SPXW) for the same expiration date: the suite's settlement model assumes PM, so only the weekly root is tradeable here. A week where no SPXW Friday is listed is skipped and journaled (`not_weekly_listed`), not traded on the wrong root.
_cash_settled_symbols_note: Symbols whose expiring legs may be cash-settled at intrinsic (European style). The entry refuses any symbol not on this list (`not_cash_settled`): an American-style ETF needs early-exercise handling this module deliberately does not have. Adding QQQ/IWM means building that first — it is a code change dressed as a config edit, which is why the guard exists.
_source_note: stream_cache_db overrides the shared stream cache path; null means the suite default (~/.cherrypick/data/marketdata/stream_cache.db). This module is a pure READ-ONLY consumer of that cache — its two expirations are served by the streamer's `expirations` request field, declared automatically every tick.
_quantity_note: Contracts per calendar side, per book. 1 keeps the experiment's unit the single structure.
_em_factor_note: The straddle-to-expected-move correction, applied to the front ATM straddle mid (cherrypick.core.structures owns the default; this key overrides per-module). 0.85 is the practitioner convention.
_entry_window_note: Entry is attempted on the entry day only, inside [entry_window_start, entry_window_end] ET, retried each tick until it fills or the window closes (an exhausted window is a journaled skipped week). 10:00 sits past the opening rotation so the EM is measured on real two-way flow.
_exit_window_note: exit_window_start..exit_window_end is the Friday scheduled-exit window the control book closes in (and the terminal every derived policy falls through to). noon_exit_start anchors the derived fri_noon variant. mon_disposition_time is when surviving longs are sold on their own Monday expiration morning. exec_window_start gates ALL management action until the open stabilizes.
_settle_note: settle_time is when expiring legs cash-settle off the last streamed trade, refused rather than used if older than settlement_max_age_seconds — a stale print would decide a week's P&L at once. A settlement missed entirely (loop down through Friday evening) is NEVER back-settled from a later print; use `python -m cherrypick.calendars.paper_loop --settle --date <expiration> --price <official print>`.
_quality_note: max_quote_age_seconds bounds every quote the module prices against (a 4-7DTE chain ticks slower than 0DTE, hence looser than flies' 120). max_leg_spread_pct is the execution gate's is-this-mark-actionable bar. strike_window_pct bounds the entry snapshot's quote fetch around spot — the EM lands well inside it.
books_header: ===== the books — two real ones, and why only two =====
_books_note: Every book shares the SAME entry fills (one plan, N books), so any divergence is exit policy and nothing else. `control` is the user-defined baseline: sell every leg in the Friday exit window, no stops, no targets, no weekend hold. `path` is the permissive superset (MEIC's `open` arm precedent): it never closes — shorts run to Friday cash settlement, longs to the Monday disposition — and its recorded mark path is what exit_policies.py derives every candidate exit rule from, read-side, with exact pairing. That derivation is why there are no pt-20/sl-50/thu-close books: one permissive arm answers the whole grid. Do not disable `path` while any experiment is running — it is the substrate, not a variant. Deliberately NOT one-variable-apart (control differs from path in short AND long handling); the read-side grid answers the single-variable questions, and the module CLAUDE.md states the exemption so nobody 'fixes' it.
_tastytrade_costs_note: Overrides for the shared cost model (cherrypick.core.fees.DEFAULT_COSTS): slippage_frac_of_spread, slippage_cap_frac_of_mid, commissions. Empty means the suite defaults — SPX carries its $0.60/contract index exchange fee automatically, and cash settlement its $5-per-ITM-symbol assignment fee.
advice_header: ===== the advised book (paper only, off by default) =====
_advice_note: When enabled AND the suite's advisor covers this module (advisor.modules.calendars in the orchestrator config — both switches must agree), the entry day's admitted advice opens an `advised:<base_book>` book beside the base, with the admitted params FROZEN on each row at entry and restated through management.effective_params at every later tick — advice lapsing mid-week can never hand an open position to rules nobody chose. Bounds are exit params only, which is exactly the advisor's v1 contract; the entry is unconditional every week, so there is nothing entry-side to advise. An artifact landing on a non-entry day admits params that open nothing until the next entry day — 'advice: baseline' on a Tuesday is the design, not a failure.
_advice_params_note: profit_target_pct and stop_loss_pct_of_debit read the COMBINED double (both sides) as fractions of the entry debit. time_exit ∈ thu_close|fri_noon|fri_close schedules the whole-structure close; long_disposition ∈ fri_close|mon_open decides whether the longs go at Friday's bell or ride to Monday (mon_open disables the whole-structure schedule — shorts settle, longs dispose, the path shape). short_strike_touch_exit closes the touched SIDE when spot crosses its strike.
